create.name: Claudia Jahn
create.bio:
Claudia Jahn is an EFT tapping coach based in Rosenheim in Bavaria, Germany, who works mostly with women who feel tense, overthink or are hard on themselves. She came to the work through her own years of feeling on edge and tired, and after exploring coaching, communication, body-based practices and energy work she found that EFT, body awareness, imagery and working with inner parts helped her most. She runs her practice alongside a day job as a data manager and family life with three daughters.

Her sessions take place online. She describes a three-step process: noticing what sets off a reaction, working with the feelings and body sensations tied to it, and then choosing a new response, and she aims to leave clients with tools they can use without her. People can book a short series of three sessions or three months of weekly support after a free introductory call. She also sells a set of seven short calming exercises, gives away a five-minute guided tapping audio, and posts short German-language tapping rounds, including a coffee-break series called Klopfkaffee, on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: Personal 1:1 Support
courses.description: Online one-to-one EFT and body-awareness sessions, booked either as three 90-minute sessions for one clearly defined issue or as three months of weekly sessions. Both begin with a free 30-minute call to decide which suits.

courses.title: 7 Quick Calm Tools for Your Everyday Life
courses.description: Seven short exercises to use in the moment, including tapping points for calming down, a breathing practice before a hard conversation, ways to clear a busy mind and a release for tight shoulders and neck. Instant access after purchase.

free_resources.title: Give Yourself 5 Minutes
free_resources.description: A free guided tapping audio of about five minutes for winding down when your thoughts will not settle, suitable for people who have never tried EFT. It is sent by email after sign-up.
